config.enable-duck-dual-drop.name: Enable Duck Dual Drop
config.enable-duck-dual-drop.tooltip: When a high-friendship duck produces a Duck Feather, it also drops its regular Duck Egg, eliminating the feather revenue loss.
config.duck-dual-drop-min-hearts.name: Dual Drop Min Hearts
config.duck-dual-drop-min-hearts.tooltip: Minimum friendship hearts required before a duck can drop both an egg and feather together (default: 4 hearts).
config.duck-dual-drop-chance.name: Dual Drop Chance
config.duck-dual-drop-chance.tooltip: Probability of dropping an egg alongside a feather at 5 friendship hearts (default: 1.0 = 100% guarantee).
config.enable-duck-feather-loom.name: Enable Loom Down Cloth
config.enable-duck-feather-loom.tooltip: Allows Duck Feathers to be processed in the Loom into luxury Down Cloth.
Reduces rabbit harvest cooldown from 4 days to 2 days (matching ducks and goats).
config.rabbit-days-to-produce.name: Rabbit Days To Produce
config.rabbit-days-to-produce.tooltip: Number of days required between rabbit produce drops (default: 2).
config.enable-rabbit-multi-drop.name: Enable Rabbit Multi-Drop
config.enable-rabbit-multi-drop.tooltip: Grants high-friendship rabbits (3+ hearts) a chance to produce bonus wool or lucky feet.
config.rabbit-multi-drop-chance.name: Rabbit Multi-Drop Chance
config.rabbit-multi-drop-chance.tooltip: Probability of bonus produce for high-friendship rabbits (default: 0.35 = 35%).
config.enable-sheep-daily-shear.name: Daily Shearing at Max Hearts
config.enable-sheep-daily-shear.tooltip: Allows sheep to be sheared every single day once they reach 5 friendship hearts.
config.enable-dinosaur-cooldown-reductio: Reduces dinosaur egg laying cooldown from 7 days down to 3 days.
config.dinosaur-days-to-produce.name: Dinosaur Days To Produce
config.dinosaur-days-to-produce.tooltip: Days required between dinosaur egg lays (default: 3 days).
config.enable-dinosaur-multi-drop.name: Enable Dinosaur Multi-Egg Drop
config.enable-dinosaur-multi-drop.toolti: Grants high-friendship dinosaurs (4+ hearts) a chance to lay a bonus second egg.
config.dinosaur-multi-drop-chance.name: Dinosaur Multi-Egg Chance
config.dinosaur-multi-drop-chance.toolti: Probability of laying a bonus egg at high friendship (default: 0.25 = 25%).
config.enable-goat-multi-drop.name: Enable Goat Multi-Milk Drop
config.enable-goat-multi-drop.tooltip: Grants high-friendship goats (4+ hearts) a chance to produce bonus goat milk on harvest.
config.goat-multi-drop-chance.name: Goat Multi-Milk Chance
config.goat-multi-drop-chance.tooltip: Probability of producing bonus goat milk at high friendship (default: 0.35 = 35%).
config.enable-void-chicken-multi-drop.to: Grants high-friendship void chickens (4+ hearts) a chance to lay a bonus second void egg.
config.void-chicken-multi-drop-chance.to: Probability of laying a bonus void egg at high friendship (default: 0.25 = 25%).
config.enable-slime-ranching-balancing.t: Increases daily Slime Ball spawn capacity and bonus slime drops when popping slime balls.
config.slime-hutch-max-balls.name: Max Daily Slime Balls
config.slime-hutch-max-balls.tooltip: Maximum number of Slime Balls that can spawn daily in a populated Slime Hutch (default: 6).
config.enable-slime-egg-press-multi-yiel: Grants a chance for the Slime Egg-Press to produce 2x Slime Eggs upon completion.
config.slime-egg-press-double-chance.too: Probability of the Slime Egg-Press producing 2x eggs (default: 0.25 = 25%).
